function.name: get_transactions
function.description: Only use this after verify_identity has returned VERIFIED in this call. Gets a verified customer's transactions. Optional filters: days (how far back, default 30, maximum 180), search (a merchant name or a category), account_type (checking or savings), and limit (default 10). Returns totals, possible duplicate charges, which card was used for card payments, and a reference for each transaction.

security_answer.description: The security answer the caller gave when verifying

days.description: How many days back to look. Leave out for 30.

search.description: A merchant name like amazon, or a category like groceries, income, dining, utilities, housing, cash, fees, transfer. Leave out for all.

limit.description: How many transactions to list. Leave out for 10.
